target: At least two of four fixed domains crossed at the recorded follow-up relative to the first scan
requested_target: The same criterion six months after the latest scan
primary_eligibility: Existing conservative complete-pair parser; age 18-50; interval 90 days to 5*365.2425 days. No exclusion based on CXL label versus domain outcome agreement.
candidate: L2 logistic regression, C selected from 0.01/0.1/1/10 by inner patient-grouped Brier loss
validation: Five patient-grouped outer folds, three patient-grouped inner folds. Both eyes remain together. Fit scaler inside training folds. Three fixed split seeds 2718, 3141, 1618; report every seed and averaged out-of-fold predictions.
sensitivity: Same recipe in the direct 4-8 month subset; narrow 5-7 month data counted, not selected for better performance
deployment: Research candidate only. No latest-plus-trend validation without a third scan; no proof of clinical absolute-risk calibration in an outcome-selected cohort. No training-set performance substituted for held-out performance.

v82_demo_extension.candidate: Same ridge logistic family, candidate C values, fold-local scaling, patient grouping and three split seeds as original. No new feature search.
v82_demo_extension.endpoint: Existing joint >=2/4 numerical threshold endpoint at later scan; no onset time inference.
v82_demo_extension.comparison: Retain prevalence and interval-only comparators; report weak or negative skill.
v82_demo_extension.near_horizon_audit: 9-15-month held-out subset at observed follow-up, descriptive only; not used to choose fit or tune thresholds.
v82_demo_extension.release: Experimental working demo with patient inputs. No clinical calibration or progression diagnosis claim.

v83_extension.forecast: Retain v8.2 cohort, labels, logistic tuning grid and grouped folds; add actual frozen baseline NKPI as a nonlinear summary of the same measurements; compare with unaugmented features on identical folds.
v83_extension.reuse_limit: Frozen NKPI was developed using overlapping records. All augmented assessments condition on this reused transformation and are not leakage-free end-to-end or external validation. Do not claim independent improvement.
v83_extension.trajectory: Predict measurement-driven change in frozen baseline NKPI logit with interval times [1, standardized baseline NKPI, standardized baseline age]. Fit ridge without an intercept; add the exact frozen age coefficient times elapsed years separately. Anchor month zero exactly; show months 0,3,6,9,12.
v83_extension.trajectory_tuning: Patient-grouped nested 5 outer/3 inner folds, three seeds 2718/3141/1618. Alpha .1,1,10,100,1000 minimizing future NKPI squared error. Compare persistence and age-only rescoring. No monotonicity or forced upward movement.
v83_extension.validation: Report actual-interval errors and descriptive 9-15 month held-out subset, no exact-horizon validation. Compare every model even if negative results. No confidence band invented.
v83_extension.quality: Numerical calculations continue with verified in-range values and an explicit scan-quality caution. Quality flag is never relabelled ok; observed significance evidence retains its quality eligibility rule.

v84_prespecified_comparison.target: Same four-domain numerical state at follow-up; 12-month response estimated at t=1. No fabricated event dates.
v84_prespecified_comparison.cohort: Same adult complete paired cohort; secondary direct 9–15 month endpoint sample.
v84_prespecified_comparison.baseline_score_recipe: Reconstruct uncalibrated NKPI: StandardScaler plus LogisticRegression C=.1 on eligible baseline CXL phenotype labels. Fit only on development patients at every outer and inner split. Positive affine original NKPI calibration cancels under downstream standardization of its logit.
v84_prespecified_comparison.selection: Minimum pooled inner Brier on 9–15 month validation rows; choose lowest dimensional candidate within 0.002. Lowest C breaks remaining ties. Refit all scaler/model weights inside each split.
benchmarks: legacy v8.3 frozen-score model (conditional reuse only)
v84_prespecified_comparison.reporting: Nested selected-procedure metrics and all candidate-family metrics, near12 primary and variable-interval secondary, calibration slope/intercept, fixed-OOF patient bootstrap, NKPI bands <50 / 50–64 / >=65. Full-fit band frequencies descriptive only.
v84_prespecified_comparison.no_inflation: No score-based probability floor, manual weighting, class balancing, synthetic events, clinic98% pseudo-labels, or new thresholds.
v84_prespecified_comparison.clinical_98_percent_claim: User report; no case-level clinic outcome dataset supplied for this fit. Neither 98% nor NKPI65 is a 12-month training target.
v84_prespecified_comparison.development_reuse: Prespecified new comparison after earlier exploratory work on the same data. Full patient-fold refitting prevents held-out labels entering the current fitting procedure; does not erase historical model-development reuse or create external validation.
